candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has had cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. Breaths were counted for one full minute with a respiratory rate of 35 while the child was calm. Chest indrawing was observed. The child is HIV exposed or infected. There was no history of convulsions and the child is not convulsing now. The child is not lethargic or unconscious, is able to drink or breastfeed, and does not vomit everything. There is no diarrhoea, ear problem, or fever. There is no stridor when calm, no wheezing, and no recurrent wheeze. A pulse oximeter was not available.
